entries.name: Apprentice

entries.name: Forest Guide
entries.description: Gain a random 4-cost champion.

entries.name: Forest Twins
entries.description: Gain 2 copies of a 2-cost champion you don't have.

entries.name: Grandmaster
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

entries.name: Heated Rivalry
entries.description: Gain a Rengar or a Kha'Zix. They gain 3 takedowns.

entries.name: Hero Of Prophecy
entries.description: Gain a 5-cost champion. Gain them again each round FOREVER.

entries.name: Journeyman
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion.

entries.name: Lost Travelers
entries.description: Gain 3 gold worth of random champions.

entries.name: Mitosis
entries.description: Gain a Tiny Champion Duplicator.

entries.name: Propagate
entries.description: Gain a copy of the first allied champion to die.

entries.name: Smurfing
entries.description: Gain a random 5 cost champion.

entries.name: Solar Gift
entries.description: Gain a Leona, Sejuani, and Kayle

entries.name: Three Me
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 3-cost champion.

entries.description: After 8 seconds, stun all enemies for 1.5 seconds.

entries.name: Backrow Star
entries.description: A random back row champion gains 75% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Bark Armor
entries.description: Your champions gain 150 shield for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Barrier
entries.description: Allies gain 1000 Shield, decaying over 5 seconds.

entries.description: Gain the Bear Primal buff for this combat.

entries.description: The first ally to die explodes, dealing 25% Max Health magic damage.

entries.name: Blaze
entries.description: Fire spreads across the board, dealing true damage to enemies.

entries.name: Booster Shot
entries.description: Up to 2 1-star champions temporarily star up during combat.
requires: Have 2 1-star champions, or a fully itemised 5-cost

entries.name: Borrowed Gear
entries.description: A champion gains a temporary recommended item.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.description: Your Tanks gain a 20% Max Health shield upon falling below 50% Health.
requires: Have at least 2 tanks on the board

entries.name: Bunch-o'-Belts
entries.description: Your allies gain 7 temporary, non-removable Giant's Belts.

entries.description: Clone your highest damage champion. The clone deals 20% damage.

entries.name: Combust
entries.description: Your champions explode on death, dealing 15% Max Health magic damage.

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.description: Increase all enemies' Max Mana by 15 until their next cast.

entries.description: Reveal your next opponent. Your team gains 12% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Diversified
entries.description: Your team gains 30 Health for each active non-unique trait.

entries.name: Downpour
entries.description: Your team gains 2 Mana Regen.

entries.name: Fellowship

entries.name: Flow
entries.description: Your champions are Unstoppable and gain 15% Attack Speed for 10 seconds.

entries.description: Gain a temporary Training Dummy with a Giant's Belt.

entries.description: Your highest Health unit grows, gaining 600 Health.

entries.description: Your highest Health ally deals 2% max Health damage per second in an area.

entries.description: Your team gains Baron Buff, increasing their stats.

requires: Have a unit on the bench

entries.name: Heroic Sacrifice
entries.description: Your 3 strongest Champions gain HEROIC POWER, but other allies are sacrificed.
requires: Have fewer than 4 fully itemised units

entries.name: Hireling
entries.description: A temporary 1-star 5-cost with 1 recommended items joins your team.

requires: Have at least 2 casters on the board

entries.description: Your highest Health unit grows, gaining 350 Health.

entries.name: Hummingbird
entries.description: Your highest Attack Speed unit shrinks, gaining 20% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Improved Reach
entries.description: Your Fighters gain 1 range.
requires: Have at least 2 fighters on the board

entries.name: Infliction
entries.description: Slow, Burn, Shred, and Sunder enemies for 8 seconds.
requires: Not already applying Shred or Sunder
Not already applying Burn or Wound, unless Inferno is active

entries.name: Iron Core

entries.name: Killer's Regret

entries.description: Every 1 second deal 5% Max Health true damage to an enemy.

requires: Have at least 2 marksmen on the board

entries.description: Your Marksmen have a 25% chance to double attack.
requires: Have at least 2 marksmen on the board

entries.name: Nature's Ally
entries.description: Every 3 ally deaths, summon a random Riftbeast.

entries.name: Nature's Wrath
entries.description: Kill EVERYONE without an item after 8 seconds.

entries.name: Petrified Dummy
entries.description: Your first champion to die turns into a 900 Health dummy with their defenses.

entries.name: Petrify Shields
entries.description: 10% Slow enemies and reduce their shields by 20% for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Phantom Armor

entries.name: Phantom Emblem

entries.name: Phantom Gloves
entries.description: Gain a temporary Thief's Gloves.

entries.name: Phantom Splash

entries.description: Gain a temporary Bramble Vest.

entries.name: Plated Shields

requires: Not for fully itemised manaless champions

entries.description: Your team heals 1% max Health per second.

entries.name: Resistant

entries.name: Revenge

entries.description: Combat start: 2 champion without items gains a temporary recommended item.

entries.name: Snacktime!

entries.name: Solitude's Cloak

entries.name: Stand Alone

entries.name: Stealthy
entries.description: Your 2 strongest Fighters or Assassins are untargetable for 6 seconds.

entries.name: Sunfire Sorcery
entries.description: Burn and Wound enemies for 10 seconds.
requires: Not already applying Burn or Wound, unless Inferno is active

entries.name: Supercritical
entries.description: Allies with Precision gain 25% Critical Strike Damage.

entries.name: Tattered Armor
entries.description: 30% Shred and Sunder enemies for 10 seconds.
requires: Not already applying Shred or Sunder

entries.name: Tiger's Visit
entries.description: Gain the Tiger Primal buff for this combat.

entries.name: Training Yard
entries.description: Gain 2 Training Dummies each with a random tank item.

entries.name: Treetop Archers

entries.name: Tremors
entries.description: Every 8 seconds, Stun enemies for 1 second.

entries.name: Turtle's Visit
entries.description: Gain the Turtle Primal buff for this combat.

entries.name: Ultra Ascension
entries.description: After 25 seconds, allies gain 300% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Verdant Vitality

entries.name: Yordle Spirit

entries.name: All Fours

entries.name: All Ones

entries.name: All Threes
entries.description: Reroll your shop with all 3-cost champions.

entries.name: All Twos
entries.description: Reroll your shop with all 2-cost champions.

entries.name: Border Village
entries.description: Reroll your shop with all 2-star 2-cost champions.

entries.name: Flash Fire

entries.name: Freeroller
entries.description: Gain 2 rerolls.

entries.name: Jungling
entries.description: Overrun the shop with Riftbeasts.

entries.name: Lucky 7
entries.description: Gain 7 shop rerolls.

entries.name: Middle Path
entries.description: Reroll your shop with all 2-star 3-cost champions.

entries.name: Refreshing Light

entries.name: Rolling Bones
entries.description: You have a 50% chance to get a free reroll with each kill.

entries.name: Roly-Polys
entries.description: For each ally champion alive at 18 seconds, gain a reroll.

entries.name: Search Party
entries.description: Each of your shops has a 4-cost in it this round until you buy one.

entries.name: Starting Town
entries.description: Reroll your shop with all 2-star 1-cost champions.

entries.name: Barter
entries.description: The next champion sold this round sells for 200% gold.

entries.name: Blood Money
entries.description: Gain 1 gold for every champion you kill.

entries.name: Bronze Spoon
entries.description: Gain 4 XP.

entries.name: Coin Flip
entries.description: Flip a coin, gain 1 gold if it's heads.

entries.name: Die Roll
entries.description: Roll a six-sided die. Gain gold equal to the result.

entries.name: Experienced
entries.description: Gain 2 XP.

entries.name: Golden Goose
entries.description: Gain 1 gold for every 1500 damage your highest damage champion deals.

entries.name: Grow Up
entries.description: Gain 16 XP.

entries.name: Life Debt
entries.description: Gain 1 gold for every 10 missing Player Health.

entries.name: Pocket Change
entries.description: Your one-star champions drop 1 gold on death.

entries.name: Slow Study
entries.description: For each ally champion alive at 15 seconds, gain 2 XP.

entries.name: Abandon Ship
entries.description: Sell your board and bench, gain 6 gold, 10 XP, and 10 rerolls.
requires: Be on a short win streak

entries.name: Cutpurse
entries.description: Every 5 seconds, your champions have a 15% chance to drop 1 Gold.

entries.name: Essence Theft
entries.description: Gain 50% bonus Coven Essence this combat.

entries.name: Fertilize
entries.description: Gain 1 XP for each enemy that dies.

entries.name: Flip Frenzy
entries.description: Flip a coin, gain 1 gold if it's heads. Continue until you flip tails.

requires: Have units of the required cost

entries.name: Minor Polymorph

entries.name: Payday
entries.description: For each ally champion that survives combat, gain 2 Gold.

entries.name: Polymorph

requires: Have units of the required cost
